manifest_row.title: Future Brahmaputra River flooding as climate changes may be underestimated, study says

screening.main_topic: A study of historical Brahmaputra River flows and how climate warming may increase future monsoon flooding risk.
screening.climate_relevance: The article directly discusses warming’s effects on monsoon rainfall and river flooding, while distinguishing those effects from natural variability in the river’s historical flow.
screening.reason: Climate change and its implications for future flooding are central to the article’s framing and analysis. The study’s finding that flood risk may be underestimated even without human-driven warming remains part of a substantial climate-related discussion.
